data.title: Dubai Canal Front Residences
data.about:
Introducing Canal Front Residences nestled on the banks of Dubai Water Canal. This is a fantastic waterfront community with 2 & 3 bedroom apartments. 

Each home offers an amazing view of the Canal and the green Safa Park as well as the astounding Dubai skyline. Come home to the most beautiful interiors, amenities like no other and a lifestyle that is perfect for a resort-style indulgence.

characteristics_module.title: Incredible to See. Amazing to Live
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Fantastic Waterfront Apartments
  • Located right on The Dubai Water Canal, minutes from Safa Park
  • Stunning views of the water canal, Dubai skyline and Safa Park
  • 2 & 3 BR apartments starting at AED 2.8M
  • Pay 60% during construction
  • Pay 40% on handover
  • Handover – Q3 2024
  • Astounding amenities, dining spots, boardwalk, and cycling tracks

location_tile.title: Enviably located at Dubai Water Canal
location_tile.description:
Nestled right on the Dubai Water Canal, Canal Front Residences is just minutes from Safa Park. It is easily accessible via Sheikh Zayed Road. It is just a short drive from Business Bay, Jumeirah, Downtown Dubai and all other major landmarks.

  • 5 mins – Jumeirah Beach
  • 8 mins – Business Bay
  • 9 mins – Downtown Dubai
  • 12 mins – Dubai International Airport
  • 14 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 18 mins – Palm Jumeirah
